thread:
Incident Bot: Paging: p95/p99 latency regression detected for /v1/streaming/generate — alert severity: high :rotating_light:
prod-monitor: Grafana alert fired: realtime_latency_p95 > 1000ms for 5m
alex: I'm on it — quick triage incoming. What's the customer impact? any 5xxs?
maria: Seeing client reports of streaming stalls and hangs. Some SDK timeouts. No spike in 5xxs yet, mostly timeouts on long streaming sessions.
sam: Verified p95 jumped from ~180ms baseline to ~1.6s at 12:42 UTC, p99 at ~5.2s. Rolling window shows sustained for ~6m.
ops-bot: Recent deploy: model-server v2.3.1 promoted at 12:35 UTC to staging->prod canary (10% then 100% at 12:40)
lilly: That timing matches. Could be kernel change or batching config. Any kvcache eviction telemetry?
prod-monitor: kvcache_miss_rate increased from 2% to 27% around 12:37
alex: Check GPU saturation and queue lengths on inference nodes — pulling metrics now.
eng-oncall: Running quick commands:
```
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference
# outputs trimmed
inference-0   Running   0/1   12d   10.0.1.12
inference-1   CrashLoopBackOff  1/1   2h   10.0.1.13
```

alex: GPU util across pool: 96-99% on several nodes, nvml shows frequent context switches. Batch queue length 200-300 requests for some shards.
maria: Streaming assembler logs show backpressure warnings:
```
W streaming_assembler.cpp:245: chunk_delay=2400ms client_id=... buffering>threshold
```
sam: Any throttles at the ingress layer? edge LB shows 429 rate ~0.1% spike but nothing large.
lilly: Let's confirm model size differences: v2.3.1 pulled new quantization kernels — could increase per-token latency.
support-bot: Customer impact: number of live sessions affected ~320 (est) over last 10m, highest in us-west-2 region.
alex: Quick mitigation options:
- rollback model-server to v2.2.8
- scale up inference pool (add nodes)
- route streaming traffic to fallback smaller model (model-x-small)
- temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 1 to avoid long batching delays
- enforce soft rate limit at edge for long streaming connections

maria: I can trigger a canary rollback for the model-server to v2.2.8. Would take ~3-4m to roll through primary pool.
sam: Meanwhile I'll spin up 4 extra inference nodes in dedicated pool and bump autoscale min.
eng-oncall: Doing quick config change to reduce batch latency:
```
# patch deployment
kubectl patch deploy model-server --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"1"}]'
```
alex: Monitor p95 after these steps. Also enable detailed kv cache logging for 15m.

ops-bot: Rollback initiated by maria -> model-server set to v2.2.8 at 12:50 UTC, target rolling restart
prod-monitor: p95 dropped to ~420ms after first 50% of rollout at 12:55 UTC
lilly: After full rollback p95 ~210ms, p99 ~880ms, streaming stall reports decreasing.
sam: Dedicated pool scaled +4 nodes, queue length reduced to <30 on all shards, GPU util ~70% now.
alex: Follow-ups for post-incident:
- root cause: suspicious change in batching/quantization kernels in v2.3.1 increased per-token latency and K/V cache thrash
- action items: add canary throttling (longer canary, slow ramp), perf tests for streaming workloads, kvcache load tests, rollback playbook improvements
maria: Filing post-incident ticket and assigning owners. Will attach graphs and logs. ETA for RCA doc: 24h.
eng-oncall: Handoff to sam for live mitigation watch for next 2h.
sam: I'm taking the watch — will keep channel updated. Setting alert sensitivity lower to catch rebounds.
lilly: Noting customer comms: CSM notified for top 10 impacted customers. Draft message ready.
alex: Closing timeline notes: incident opened 12:42 UTC, rollback started 12:50, mitigated 12:56, watch active until 14:56.
support-bot: Incident severity changed to resolved -> monitoring
